content:
Maya Lee: Heads up — we need alignment on the new 'capacity onramp' initiative before Q3 planning. Major cross-team deps: runtime autoscaling hooks, infra reserved pools, and security audit for private deployments. Can we sync on owners, sequencing, and launch criteria?

Devin Ortega: When can eng commit to API changes? We need a clear schema and a rollout window to coordinate infra provisioning.

Jordan Park: Proposing a 2-week phased rollout with a canary, then regional ramp. Runtime needs three things from product/eng: 1) API contract, 2) staged model variant list & fallback rules, 3) KV-cache invalidation plan for tenant onramp.

Sanjay Patel: From infra: we can provision two reserved GPU pools (us-west-2, eu-west-1) in ~3 weeks if we get confirmed capacity commitments and billing tags. Need final cost center and project IDs. Also we need a network fallback path for cross-region saturation.

Lucy Chen: Security notes: private deploy audit will take ~5 business days once code is ready. KMS integration must be included in the e2e smoke tests. Also request up-to-date dataflow diagrams for the auditors.

Maya Lee: OK — let's capture owners and deadlines. Quick Q: can runtime support per-tenant throttles and burst settings? That will affect infra sizing.

Jordan Park: Yes, runtime can support per-tenant throttles but we need the schema. Proposed field: `tenant_rate_limit`. Example config below:
```json
{"tenant_rate_limit": {"qps": 10, "burst": 50}}
```
We also need to decide default behavior when a tenant exceeds limit (queue vs reject).

Devin Ortega: We can add the `tenant_rate_limit` field this sprint (ending Fri). Will need API review and short migration notes for existing customers. @Maya can you prioritize the docs PR?

Maya Lee: Will do. Proposed launch criteria (draft): 1) Latency baseline: p95 <= 120ms for Tier-A traffic under target load; 2) Automated fallback to a smaller model variant if latency/SLOs degrade; 3) Cost guardrails per 1k tokens (product to define exact thresholds); 4) Security audit passed and KMS verified.

Sanjay Patel: For infra we also need confirmed tagging and billing project IDs before provisioning. Blocker: cloud vendor capacity offers vary by region — procurement/partners needs to confirm.

Lucy Chen: Security checklist (short): threat model, KMS key rotation proof, audit log retention = 90 days, automated smoke test that exercises PII scrubber. We also require a small compliance run on the canary.

runtime-bot: deploy-status: canary build 382 queued for runtime-test; ETA ~4h.

Maya Lee: Proposed owners: Product=Maya, Eng=Devin, Runtime=Jordan, Infra=Sanjay, Security=Lucy. Can everyone ack and paste any blockers by EOD? I'll assemble an action list and PRD.

Devin Ortega: :thumbsup: ack. Blocker: model quantization perf regression observed in last eval — need a baseline eval and rollback plan.

Jordan Park: :eyes: ack. Blocker: KV cache hot-prefix behavior under multi-tenant burst; will run sim and report results.

Sanjay Patel: :+1: ack. Blocker: pending confirmation from cloud partners on guaranteed capacity in eu-west-1.

Lucy Chen: :raised_hands: ack. No additional blockers besides audit scheduling.

Maya Lee: Thanks. I'll post a short PRD and agenda for a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. If you can't make it, DM me and I'll capture notes.

runtime-bot: calendar: meeting created — "capacity-onramp sync" 10:30 PT tomorrow. Link posted in #calendar.
